intent: Write JUnit 5 + AssertJ tests (reactor-test StepVerifier for Mono/Flux, Mockito for collaborators, no external services, no Thread.sleep) for IngestionController. Assert ONLY against the ast_hints method table; at least one given/when/then case per table method and per branch. Unit contract: Context Telemetry Ingestion & Validation inbound adapter: @RestController, POST /api/v1/telemetry/packets consuming application/json with a SINGLE JSON object body (type IngressPacketRequest, parameter annotated @Valid @RequestBody; WebFlux validation answers 400 at the boundary for constraint violations). ingest maps the request with request.toDomain(clock.instant()) (IllegalArgumentException -> ResponseStatusException 400), calls service.ingest(packet) and answers 202 Accepted with no body on success (on_success); when the service errors with IllegalStateException (stream overflow, on_overflow) answer 503 Service Unavailable via ResponseStatusException - never a silent drop and never 5xx for an invalid-but-bounded sample (those are tagged, not rejected). Delivery posture: at-least-once inbound; the dedup identity (deviceId, metric, tDevice) is owned by ReorderHistoryService so client retries never append duplicate revisions. Self-registered with @RestController; fully non-blocking. Cover with WebTestClient bound to the controller and a mocked IngestPacketService: 202 on valid body, 400 for a constraint violation AT THE BOUNDARY (blank deviceId, empty samples) and unknown metric, 503 when the service emits IllegalStateException, JSON single-object body.
